== Notes ==
* The damage bonus affects direct damage; damage from degeneration and hexes is excluded.
* Make sure the target has a [[cover]] enchantment, since a well-placed [[List of enchantment removal skills|enchantment removal]] from a [[foe]] will cause your party member to die.
* Dying while enchanted by this skill does not count as a [[death]]; teams on [[Kill Count]] and [[Alliance Battle]] maps will not be awarded points for deaths of players under the effects of Vengeance.

{{anomaly|This skill's [[duration]] can only be extended by any [[of Enchanting]] modifier on the target's weapon. The caster's weapon and buffs like Blessed Aura do not extend the duration.}}
